decisions.reason: The data processing agreement tool supports the firm's compliance direction for agencies, has kept its own page across both years, and costs little to maintain, so it shows no shortfall against aspirations that would trigger search for other uses.
As the flagship platform featured on the home page in both years and central to the agency-focused strategy, it meets aspirations and anchors the firm's direction.
The configurable managed hosting plan sits close to the core offer and has kept a stable dedicated page, so it fits current routines and gives no signal of underperformance.

Extended PHP security support is newer and only mentioned on the website, so its results are still uncertain, but it fits the security and compliance promise and organisational slack lets the firm carry it, despite some risk it gets folded into other offers.
